sentences.text: Lauren Helen Graham -LRB- born March 16 , 1967 -RRB- is an American actress and author .

She is best recognized for her role as Lorelai Gilmore on the television series Gilmore Girls -LRB- 2000 -- 07 -RRB- , for which she received two Screen Actors Guild Award nominations , one Golden Globe nomination , and five Satellite Award nominations .
